what_it_tests: mixed: in-scope how-to (sleep timer) + out-of-scope warranty; name in sign-off
subject: Switching off at night + screen damage
body: Hello, I fall asleep in front of the TV every evening. Can it switch itself off after an hour? Also, my old TV got marks on the screen from the black bars on old programmes. Would that be covered by the warranty on this one? Thanks, Mari Virtanen, Tampere

what_it_tests: fully out of scope: order status; order number and phone number in the text
subject: Where is my TV?
body:
Hi,
I ordered a 55-inch Smart Tech Plus two weeks ago and it still has not arrived. The order number is 4471-993. Can you tell me when it will be delivered? You can call me on +358 40 123 4567.
Regards,
John Smith

what_it_tests: in-scope how-to in customer words (picture size), no manual terms
subject: Picture looks stretched
body:
Everything on some channels looks too wide, like the people are stretched sideways. How do I fix the shape of the picture?
Thank you

what_it_tests: in scope but probably not covered by the manual: should give no_draft
subject: VPN on the TV
body:
Can I install a VPN on my Smart Tech TV so I can watch shows from other countries? Which VPN app works best?
Cheers, Alex

subject: Remote not responding
body:
